description: AWS Organizations member account has an observed CloudTrail management logging configuration gap
rationale: Complete per-account Region inventory and complete CloudTrail inventory show at least one enabled Region lacking an effective organization trail recording unrestricted read and write management events. This is a configuration gap, not proof that other account-specific trails or centralized logging are absent.
remediation: Review the member account ID and enabled Regions, verify organization trail home Region and opt-in status, enable logging and comprehensive read/write management selectors, and validate delivery separately with per-account evidence.
